Subject: Request to open backfill req — Senior SRE (engineer offboarding)

Hi team,

Quick context: Priya in SRE has accepted an offer elsewhere and her last day is 3/20. Hiring manager (Marcus) is asking to open a backfill for a Senior SRE to avoid coverage gaps for our on-call rotation and upcoming reliability work.

Attached: req_form_v2.pdf, jd_senior_sre.md (draft JD).

Asking for: approval to open the requisition (headcount already approved in Q1 plan but needs formal req open + job posting). Ive filled out the cost-center and landing compensation band on the form.

Questions for you:
- Stephanie: any concerns on the hiring cadence or approvals we should route through (finance/compliance)?
- Marcus: can you confirm interview panel and expected interview loop length (30 / 60 / 90)?
- Logan/Evelyn: would either of you be available to interview (tech + on-call scenario) if we post this week?

Proposed timeline: post by 2/23, first-round screens 2/25–3/5, onsite/loop 3/9–3/13.

Thanks,
Monica

-- 
Monica Patel
Recruiting Lead, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference
attachments: req_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf), jd_senior_sre.md (text/markdown)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to open backfill req — Senior SRE (engineer offboarding)

Thanks Monica — good flag. A couple quick items before I greenlight:

1) Budget confirmation: finance needs a sign-off that this sits in the existing Q1 headcount (you mentioned yes) — please paste the finance approval thread or ticket.
2) Interview panel: Marcus, please confirm the final panel (I prefer 4 interviews: 1 system design, 1 reliability/case study, 1 coding/debugging, 1 leadership/collaboration).
3) Hiring bar & comp: Marcus/Logan, confirm the comp band (range) you want posted and whether we should allow remote candidates in EU/APAC or limit to US-first for expediting.

Assuming the above, I approve opening the req. If finance still needs formal sign-off we can route to budget-ops but I don't expect blockers.

One more ask: please include a short note in the JD about on-call expectations and time-zone overlap minimums.

Stephanie
Director, Talent (hiring operations)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to open backfill req — Senior SRE (engineer offboarding)

Stephanie — agreed on all points. Confirming:

- Budget: Q1 headcount approval exists under cost center ENG-SRE-1; finance ticket HR-1123 (see link Monica added) has the allocation.
- Panel: 4 interviews as suggested. Proposed interviewers: Logan (systems), Evelyn (reliability scenarios), Marcus (case study / ops), Stephanie or Monica for hiring bar/culture. (I can cover the ops interview on short notice.)
- Comp band: $190k–$220k base (US) + equity band 0.15–0.4%. Open to remote US and CA candidates only for now; prefer US-first to simplify payroll.

Timeline looks fine — we should post 2/23 and ask recruiting to push 2–3 screened candidates by 3/1.

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, SRE
Redwood Inference
